rationale.conceptual: The method is a custom, non-orthogonal tight-binding model with DFT-derived parameters, requiring explicit derivation of dynamical matrix, electron-photon and electron-phonon matrix elements, and a fourth-order perturbation expression for Raman intensity. Full Brillouin zone integration with all resonant processes and combination modes is a research-grade algorithm needing deep quantum condensed matter expertise.
rationale.execution: The pipeline comprises many interacting computational stages: NTB model setup, structural relaxation, band structure computation, phonon dispersion calculation, matrix element evaluation, linewidth model, full Raman spectrum integration, overtone-only extraction, and peak reporting. Requires implementing complex physics models from multiple references and generating several scored artifacts. The orchestration is non-trivial but not extremely fragile, and no exotic tooling is needed.
